units.text: INT. LIGHTHOUSE FOG-SIGNAL ROOM - NIGHT
The brass horn sits silent.
Rain ticks on the glass.
IGNATIUS BRAND (60s, salt-cracked hands, wool cap) pours tea for TAMSIN OKORO (20s, relief keeper, soaked parka).
Quiet night.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Always is, after the horn stops.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: They sip.
The kettle ticks as it cools.
Tamsin smiles.
Thought it'd be worse out here.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Ignatius stares at the floor between her boots.
Water pools there.
Too much water, and it runs uphill toward the horn.
You came up alone?
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: Yes. Why?
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Below them, slow wet footsteps climb the iron stairs.
Tamsin and Ignatius both freeze, cups halfway to their mouths.
The horn BLARES on its own.
They scramble for the hatch, collide, and drag it shut together.
That's not the tide.
units.name: IGNATIUS
